IMG_2207.prompt: Sunset over a quiet Atlantic beach in the Algarve, low orange sun, calm sea, wet sand reflecting the light, a few distant rocks, nobody on the beach.

variants.watcher: A small dark silhouette of a person now stands knee-deep in the sea in the right third of the photo, facing the camera, barely noticeable.

They smile; Daniel smiles less. To Daniel's right, at the right edge of the photo, an empty wooden chair with a women's red coat hanging on its back. Phone flash.

Helena Sousa'. Taken with the phone flash.
